# Pejji Web Design

> Pejji Web Design (brand: Pejji) builds fast, secure, beautiful websites for Nigerian small businesses, starting from N60,000. Security-first and NDPA-compliant, delivered in as little as 48 hours. Serving Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, and businesses nationwide.

## What Pejji does
- Custom websites for Nigerian SMEs: professionals, local businesses, restaurants, fashion and ecommerce brands, personal brands.
- WhatsApp ordering, online payments (Paystack), booking, and the trust signals that turn visitors into customers.
- Every build is security-first (security headers, HTTPS, privacy/NDPA baseline) and audited by our sister brand Securva.

## Pricing (Nigerian Naira)
- Card, a one-page digital business card site: from N60,000
- Starter, a professional landing page: from N150,000
- Growth, a business site with booking: from N300,000
- Pro, a full ecommerce store: from N800,000

## Common questions
- How much does a website cost in Nigeria? Pejji starts at N60,000 for a professional one-page site, up to N800,000+ for a full ecommerce store.
- How fast can I get a website? As little as 48 hours for a starter site.
- Do you build online stores? Yes, with product catalogs, cart, and Paystack payments.
- Is it secure? Yes, every Pejji site is security-first and NDPA-compliant, audited by Securva.
